request: Cap the accepted callback chain for each endpoint at five entries, so editor suggestions stay manageable.

source.request: Cap the accepted callback chain for each endpoint at five entries, so editor suggestions stay manageable.
source.settled: Route registration overloads support up to ten handlers.
source.why: A five-callback cap would reject chains that the ten-handler overloads support.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
